title: Fractional strike integer truncation in scan router, alternative contracts, and contracts endpoint
description: In backend/app/routers/scan.py:1280 (contract=f"{symbol}|{int(strike)}|..."), line 1297 (strike=int(strike)), line 1434 (strike=int(alt_strike)), and backend/app/routers/contracts.py:127 (_parse_strikes digit check), fractional strikes such as 182.5 or 552.5 are truncated to integers or rejected with HTTP 422. This causes broker payloads and trade cards to reference incorrect whole-number strike contracts, altering cost, delta, and breakeven.
remediation: Replace int(strike) casts with normalized float string formatting (e.g. f'{strike:g}') and update _parse_strikes regex to permit decimal values.

title: Non-monotonic +19 point discontinuity in option contract IV scoring
description: In backend/app/scoring/contract_validator.py:361-372, the formula branches at preferred_iv_max (default 55). At IV 55, the score evaluates to 0. At IV 56, it switches to 20 * (1 - (iv - 55)/(100 - 55)), evaluating to 19. This causes IV 60 to score 17 while IV 50 scores 9, violating monotonicity and inflating composite contract scores by up to 2.85 points.
remediation: Smooth the penalty curve so that score at preferred_iv_max connects continuously to the elevated penalty tier (or drops to 0 smoothly without jumping).

title: Heston parameter grid search boundary pinning and Feller condition violation
description: In backend/app/models/heston_cache.py:306-314, a coarse 2x2x2x2 parameter grid pins calibrations to extreme box boundaries (kappa=0.5, theta=0.08, sigma_v=0.6, rho=-0.8). This violates the Feller condition by 4.5x (2*kappa*theta = 0.08 < 0.36 = sigma_v^2), producing artificial tail heaviness that overprices out-of-the-money options at target barriers and inflates R/R ratios.
remediation: Enforce Feller condition regularization or fine-tune parameter bounds during calibration.

title: IEEE-754 precision noise in frontend capitalAtRisk calculation
description: In frontend/lib/risk.ts:20, capitalAtRisk(mid, contracts) performs raw JavaScript double-precision multiplication (mid * contracts * 100). On values like 6.90 * 3 * 100, floating-point representation produces 2070.0000000000005, requiring rounding in consumers.
remediation: Apply Math.round(mid * 100) * contracts / 100 or Math.round to integer cents.

title: Strict regex pattern matching in parseApiError defaults non-standard errors to keep
description: In frontend/lib/apiError.ts, parseApiError expects error messages to match the strict regex /→ (\d{3})(?:: ([\s\S]*))?$/. Unstructured errors or exceptions not adhering to this format return status null and default to verdict 'keep', preventing automated eviction of invalid drafts.
remediation: Support fallback extraction of HTTP status codes from Axios/Fetch error objects or response bodies.
